_doc: ONE FOOD-SOURCE COUNT, ONE SIGNED SHIFT OF THE CONSTRUCTION-AND-WIRING WAVE'S WRITER LANE W0, ODQ §934.105 (the cloud chair signs by the owner's delegation of 2026-11-06, vetoable; a successor chair does not inherit this signature; the chair's ruling R-W7 (c), docs/chair/2026-11-07/WIRING-RULINGS-2026-11-07.md). THE CAUSE, ONE (commit 3d1df12d7 on lane/wiring-w0-2026-11-07): foodSecurity's food chains, activeChains, activeChainsCount and diversityNote derive from the food record's foodSources (FOOD-3), each chain a source TYPE (grain and the mill one type); trade is the import share (record 02), never a source of the place's own, its key kept false so the shape holds. The chains were judged by looser tests of their own and counted 'Trade & imports', so the count disagreed with the record's sources on every one of the golden 525. Mechanics that read the count follow it: the prosperity bonus (surplus with >= 3 chains and a granary) and the resilience score's diversity term (which the defence profile's disasters-and-famine score reads). MEASURED over the 525 before the write: 525 disagreements -> 0 (by length and by type); red-first tests/generators/w0WriterAgreement.test.js's cause-4b block, red at c99531cf9, green at 3d1df12d7. THE MOVE, MEASURED before the write at the stage (the tree of 3d1df12d7 with the door paths carried from the branch, records 01 and 02 committed; the step is this one cause): the generator golden master 525 of 525 rows (thorp 84, hamlet 84, village 84, town 105, city 84, metropolis 84; the key set identical), 1847e8b7.. -> 8141a111..; the espionage fence's driven corpus 360 of 360 rows (60 a tier), 360/360 distinct, 281ca040.. -> 67c9727b..; the herald knowledge desk 1 of 435 rows (the year-one desk re-dealt by the born realm's food figures); the PDF golden view-model snapshot, one canon value: defense.scoreAvg 47 -> 43 (the resilience score's diversity term); the dossier prose manifest 0 (its suite green at the stage). No new words: the diversity note's five strings are unchanged; which one a place carries moves.
